  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מתווכים בפקיסטן התכנסו; ארה"ב הודיעה על השהיה זמנית של פעולות נגד אנרגיה — פתח לדיפלומטיה.

Situation report — Day 27

  • Active explosions reported in central Israel. Reports of successive blasts heard this morning.
  • US/Israeli air campaign on Iran continues. Second US pause announced by Trump: 10 days (deadline 6 Apr 2026, 20:00 ET) citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Pakistan hosting mediators now. Senior Saudi, Turkish, Egyptian envoys present. Pakistan is the lead intermediary.
  • Tomahawk strike tally exceeds 850 in first four weeks of Operation Epic Fury — more TLAMs than in the 2003 Iraq invasion.
  • Diego Garcia missile incident raises European alert. Reports Iran has targeted or threatened European military infrastructure.
  • Iran allows passage through Hormuz only for Russia, India, China. Other flagged vessels still blocked.
  • Emergency landing of a second US aerial refueler in Israel this morning. (Second emergency refueler event in 48 hours; first landed in UK yesterday.)
  • Northern front active daily: IDF reports a rare raid on the Syria–Lebanon border to counter entrenchment. IDF soldier killed in south Lebanon recent reports.
  • Saudi air base attack reportedly heavily damaged a US surveillance aircraft.
  • Airspace: Iran and Iraq airports remain closed. Regional commercial traffic reduced.
  • Domestic: Dozens detained after anti-war protest in Tel Aviv turned violent.
  • Operational note: US reportedly preparing for prolonged ground options in Iran per Pentagon reporting.
  • 🟢 Good News: Mediators are meeting in Pakistan and a 10-day pause was announced — a window for diplomacy exists.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
